internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: We've been in this flower business since 1998! We are thrilled to bring you the opportunity to purchase grower-direct designs, hand-crafted right here on our farm. Nestled in the wine country of Baja California along the Pacific Ocean, Floral Treasure grows and manufactures premium dried and preserved floral decorations.
